headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw for 355 yards and three touchdowns, and the NFC North-leading Chicago Bears beat the Detroit Lions 34-22 to snap a 10-game losing streak against division opponents on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky throws 3 TDs, Bears beat Lions 34-22

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw three touchdown passes in the first half, moving ahead of Brett Favre for second place on the career list, and the New Orleans Saints rolled to their eighth straight victory Sunday, 51-14 over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees passes Favre with 3 TDs, Saints  crush Bengals 51-14

headlines.description: Rookie Baker Mayfield threw a season-high three touchdown passes and rookie Nick Chubb streaked 92 yards for a TD and the Cleveland Browns ended a four-game losing streak with a stunning 28-16 win over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chubb has 92-yard TD run in Browns' 28-16 win over Falcons

events.name: New England Patriots at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw three touchdown passes in the first half and the Indianapolis Colts' defense forced a late turnover Sunday to preserve a 29-26 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Ebron lead Colts past struggling Jaguars 29-26

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for 249 yards and two touchdowns, outplaying Arizona counterpart Josh Rosen in a matchup of two of the NFL's bright young quarterbacks, and the Kansas City Chiefs rolled past the Cardinals 26-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 2 TD passes as Chiefs beat Cardinals 26-14

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Matt Barkley stunningly sparked Buffalo's bumbling offense with two touchdown passes, including one to offensive tackle Dion Dawkins. LeSean McCoy broke out of a season-long slump with 113 yards rushing and a pair of TD runs, and the Bills embarrassed...
headlines.shortLinkText: Barkley, Bills light up listless Jets in 41-10 laugher

events.name: Washington Redskins at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Washington yielded 501 yards and forced Tampa Bay to punt once all day.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith throws for 178 yards, TD; Redskins beat Bucs 16-3

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Philip Rivers took nearly 20 minutes to complete his first pass, the Los Angeles Chargers got gashed on a long fake punt and the offense put up a season low in yards.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers leads Chargers to 6th straight win, 20-6 over Raiders

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Jones ran for career highs of 145 yards and two scores, Aaron Rodgers and Davante Adams connected for two touchdown passes and the Green Bay Packers beat the Miami Dolphins 31-12 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones helps Packers run away for 31-12 win over Dolphins

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Brandin Cooks rushed for a 9-yard touchdown with 5:49 to play on the first snap after Dante Fowler forced and recovered a fumble by Russell Wilson, and the Los Angeles Rams bounced back from their first loss of the season with a 36-31 victory over the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams make late defensive stand, hold off Seahawks 36-31

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott had 151 yards rushing and his go-ahead 1-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter helped the Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles 27-20 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elliott, Prescott lead Cowboys past Eagles 27-20

events.name: New York Giants at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw a 3-yard touchdown pass to Sterling Shepard with 53 seconds left and the New York Giants snapped a five-game losing streak by beating the San Francisco 49ers 27-23 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning's late TD pass leads Giants past 49ers 27-23
